I can't write files from this conversation, so the file is below for you to save at `/home/dev/13df96/app/notes/pointer-lock.json`.

FILE: app/notes/pointer-lock.json
```json
{ "lockedNoButton": false, "lockedButtonHeld": false, "rightDrag": true, "touchDrag": true }
```

I answered from the notes and type declarations alone, without running anything. Note 66 and note 40 say a drag with button 0, 1 or 2 turns the camera, so `rightDrag` is true. The notes don't say whether drag deltas come from `clientX`/`clientY` or from `movementX`/`movementY`. I assumed `clientX`/`clientY`, which you said stay fixed under pointer lock. That makes both locked cases false, even with the left button held. `touchDrag` is true because a touch contact reports button 0, but the notes don't mention touch for `attachFreeControl`, so please verify it on a tablet. The `lockedButtonHeld` answer depends on the same unverified assumption about the delta source.
